opening.quote: Good morning, Tidewell homes, my name and is Femke.
opening.comment: The agent greeted the caller and gave both her name and the company name, though the transcript has garbled wording and a typo in the company name.

verification.quote: Can I your full names and the order lumber or i postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for full name and postcode before discussing the order, and the caller confirmed both, so verification was done before the payment details were shared.

understanding.quote: So you've disputed that payment with bank in want to know the next step?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the issue (bank dispute on the EUR 120 payment) and did not re-ask for information already given, though the caller's question was never fully answered.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Your back will contact you which their decision.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent gave no incorrect amounts or timelines, but the policy says the Payments team replies within 2 working days, and the agent instead implied the bank decides without stating that timeline.

process_compliance.quote: I'll make a note on your order that you've opened a dispute.
process_compliance.comment: The agent did not hand the chargeback to the Payments team as required; she only added a note to the order and did not pass the case on, and she did not ask permission before the silent pause.

Agent: I'll make a note on your order that you've opened a dispute.
communication.comment: The agent was polite, apologised early, but the caller's question went unanswered and there was no acknowledgement of the caller's frustration beyond a brief apology.

closing.quote: Is there anything else I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent asked if there was anything else and closed politely, but the next steps were unclear and she promised an email without specifying what it would contain.
